name: Spike - does qualifying override STARTING_POSITION
notes: The grid spike proved we can place the player anywhere with a one-based STARTING_POSITION. This asks whether that survives a qualifying session in the same launch. The race asks for position 8 of 8, so unless you qualify last the two answers are far apart: start 8th and STARTING_POSITION wins, start where you qualified and qualifying wins - which would mean an explicit grid is only expressible in a launch with no qualifying in front of it. YOU MUST SET A VALID QUALIFYING LAP, and it must be a clean flying lap rather than an out-lap: qualify last and the probe is void, because both answers then predict the same grid slot. The sprint-feature run recorded zero laps for the player in qualifying, which is exactly the way to waste this one. Note where you qualified, then note your grid slot before the lights go out, and whether Car 1 to Car 7 are still in that order or have been reshuffled by their qualifying times. Finish the three-lap race so both sessions land in race_out.json. Second question, free with the same run: does the qualifying session carry a raceResult of its own? Practice and qualifying carried none in the sprint-feature capture, but nobody had set a time in either. If it does, that array is the grid for the next launch, which is what grid reconstruction across a launch seam needs.
